claims.summary: On the charged ternary graph, arbitrary normalized F4 weights on compatible defect sets, uniform within each corrected-flow fiber, that annihilate ordinary old-generator multiples through D force every defect marginal with sum vertex degrees<=D to vanish. With a=floor(D/Delta), max(4,2Delta)<=L<=D and 2L/epsilon<=a, all moments through2L and the degree-L pairing coincide with the canonical charged quotient. Fixed weighted error maps with weight+error+column degree<=L therefore have the same kernels and ranks for every such mixture. Degree-r defect tilts have mass Q(0) and retain equality when the small potential has support<=a-r.

The remaining upper band and actual PC closure are open; ordinary NS annihilation is not identified with PC closure.
